title: Market lowers Selic rate expectation to 13.50% by end of 2026
subtitle: Official Focus Report forecast indicates a revision to 13.50% by the end of next year
excerpt: The financial market has lowered its Selic interest rate projection from 13.75% to 13.50% by the end of 2026, according to the Focus Report.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
The financial market has lowered its expectation for the benchmark Selic interest rate from 13.75% to 13.50% by the end of 2026. The change was disclosed in the Focus Report, published this Monday (21) by the Central Bank.

The revised projection indicates that economic agents are now working with a rate of 13.50% for the aforementioned period. This adjustment reflects updated market expectations regarding the future economic scenario.

As an official source of macroeconomic projections, the Focus Report compiles estimates from various financial institutions and serves as a benchmark for analyzing monetary policy and investment decisions.

With information from Agência Brasil.
